backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features documented.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color schemes using oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vmart Smart Inventory Management System that loads the React app from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component that sets up TanStack Router with routes for Dashboard, Inventory, Billing, Analytics, Replenishment, Stores, Vendors, and Settings pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with responsive header, sidebar navigation, mobile menu, theme toggle, notifications, and user profile dropdown for the inventory management system.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the ICP backend actor with authentication support, automatically recreating the actor when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder React Query hooks for dashboard data, products, stores, and vendors that will call backend actor methods once implemented.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with professional blue-green retail color scheme defining CSS variables for light/dark themes and chart colors using oklch color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that renders the App component wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Analytics.tsx: Analytics dashboard page displaying sales charts (daily/monthly), category distribution pie chart, top-performing products, and slow-moving inventory with trend indicators and time period filters.
frontend/src/pages/Billing.tsx: Point-of-sale billing interface with barcode scanning, shopping cart management, quantity adjustments, GST calculation, discount application, and invoice printing functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard overview showing key metrics (sales, products, stock alerts), revenue charts, top-selling products with trends, and low/out-of-stock item alerts.
frontend/src/pages/Inventory.tsx: Inventory management page with product listing table, search/filter by category, CRUD operations for products including barcode, pricing, GST, stock levels, and reorder thresholds.
frontend/src/pages/Replenishment.tsx: Automated replenishment system displaying reorder suggestions based on stock levels and sales velocity, plus purchase order management with status tracking (pending, approved, in-transit, delivered).
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page with tabbed interface for profile information, notification preferences, security settings, and system configuration. Includes form inputs for user details and toggle switches for various notification and security options.
frontend/src/pages/Stores.tsx: Store management page displaying multiple store locations with stats overview (total stores, products, sales, managers) and individual store cards showing location, manager, product count, and sales data.
frontend/src/pages/Vendors.tsx: Vendor management page with searchable table listing suppliers, their contact information, products supplied, total orders, and ratings. Includes stats cards for total vendors, products supplied, and total orders.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, sidebar colors, border radius variables, custom animations (accordion), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file defining Vmart retail inventory system architecture with MongoDB backend, React frontend, JWT authentication, multi-store support, and seven pending feature requests including authentication, dashboard, inventory, billing, replenishment, analytics, and notifications.
